description: A balance on the first hand, then a square through of two hands.

walkthrough.line: Balance on the {firstHand} hand you are about to pull by with, then square through two.
walkthrough.teach: Take {firstHand} hands with the dancer you are facing and balance: step in toward them and touch, then step back and touch. Keep that hand and pull by on it, then give your {secondHand} hand to the dancer you are facing now and pull by again. Eight beats, and the balance is what interrupts the square through.
